Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to critically evaluate the accuracy of the information extracted from the search results. Specifically, it accepted the claim that "Napol on Alexandre Berthier" was the father of Alexandre Berthier, 3rd Prince of Wagram, without verifying the spelling or identity. The name "Napol on" is a clear corruption of "Napoléon" (likely due to OCR errors or bad scraping of the text "Napoléon Alexandre Berthier"), but the agent treated this garbled text as a definitive fact. Furthermore, the agent did not cross-reference this with other search results or authoritative sources (like the Wikipedia page directly) to confirm the father's full name before concluding the lineage. This led to a hallucinated or corrupted name for the father, even though the final answer (Jean-Baptiste Berthier) happened to be correct based on the "grandson of" clue, the intermediate step of identifying the father was flawed due to the agent's failure to clean/verify the extracted data.
